req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) return application/json content type with HTTP 2xx responses. Tests cover: (1) positive EP cases for each method verifying exact Content-Type header value and status code 200; (2) negative cases verifying wrong-method requests return 405 (not 2xx); (3) boundary cases verifying the Content-Type header contains exactly 'application/json' and not a superset/subset string. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact Content-Type strings, and both sides of method routing logic.

tests.name: test_get_returns_application_json_content_type
actions: Import app via from httpbin.core import app
Inspect response status and Content-Type header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> /get endpoint -> view_get() -> jsonify() -> Content-Type: application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'url' in data

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_text_plain
actions: Send requests to all five echo endpoints
Assert Content-Type is exactly application/json and NOT text/html or text/plain
expected: Content-Type starts with 'application/json' for all endpoints
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> jsonify() sets Content-Type: application/json -> boundary: must not be any other MIME type
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_text_plain():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} got {r.status_code}"
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f"{method} {path} Content-Type was {ct!r}"
        assert 'text/html' not in ct, f"{method} {path} Content-Type was {ct!r}"
        assert 'text/plain' not in ct, f"{method} {path} Content-Type was {ct!r}"

tests.name: test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_required_keys
preconditions: GET /get endpoint returns JSON with url, args, headers, origin keys
actions: Assert all required keys present with correct types
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> view_get() -> get_dict('url','args','headers','origin') -> jsonify -> keys must exist
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_required_keys():
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['args'].get('foo') == 'bar'
    assert data['args'].get('baz') == 'qux'

preconditions: POST /post accepts JSON body and echoes it
actions: Assert status 200, Content-Type application/json, and json field in response equals sent body
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> view_post() -> get_dict includes 'json' key -> jsonify -> echoes parsed JSON body

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_with_json_body_echoes_json_field_and_content_type():
    payload = {'test': 123, 'nested': {'a': 1}}
    r = client.post('/post', json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')

    assert data is not None
    assert 'json' in data
    assert data['json'] == {'test': 123, 'nested': {'a': 1}}
    assert data['json']['test'] == 123

tests.name: test_content_type_charset_boundary_includes_application_json
preconditions: Flask jsonify may append charset to Content-Type
actions: Assert it starts with 'application/json' and does not start with 'text/' or 'application/xml'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> boundary: MIME type prefix must be exactly 'application/json', not a near-miss like 'text/json' or 'application/xml'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_charset_boundary_includes_application_json():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/json')
    assert not ct.startswith('application/xml')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/html')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/plain')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    parts = ct.split(';')
    assert parts[0].strip() == 'application/json'
